howto.goal: Be on the last team with dice. Bid on how many of one face are on the table, or call the last bid a lie.
howto.setup: Each team of two shares one pool of ten dice. Each player sees only their own dice.

sections.title: Teams
sections.text: You and your partner share a pool. Talk in the open — the other team hears everything.

sections.title: Bidding
sections.text: A bid says a face and a count for the whole table. Each new bid must raise the count or the face.

sections.title: Calling a lie
sections.text: Call the bid and everyone shows their dice. The team that is wrong loses a die from its pool.

controls: Click a bid button to raise the count or the face.
Click Call the bid a lie to challenge the last bid.
Use the table chat to coordinate with your partner — openly.

frames.say: Your dice, and your partner's are separate.
Between a team, fives add up fast.
Two teams sit down, five dice each.
The first bid is low: two fives.
A rival raises to four fives, counting their own dice.
Your partner calls the lie. Everyone shows their dice.
Only three fives exist, so the rival team loses a die.

demo.outro: Tell your partner what you hold — the other team is listening, so be careful.

steps.say: Count the face you hold most of, then say it in chat so your partner knows.
Bid low at first; you can raise on your next turn.
Remember the other team hears your hints too.
Call a lie when the count is more than your team's dice can support.
